My favorite thing to do nowadays
is walking under the bridge!
I will cross all the bridges in Unova!

Derleth: Fweet fweet...
Fweeeeeet fweet fweet...

Derleth: What is piercing my mind is
a sad sound.{VAR BE01}
What is piercing my heart is
a cold night wind.

Derleth: Fwee... Fwee...
Fffweeet fweet...

Aickman: How about this? This sound!
Doesn't it get to your heart? Your mind?

Aickman: I know my sound doesn't fit
this city, this town.{VAR BE01}
But I... I cannot change
my life, my style.

Aickman: This is my best friend, my pal.
It knows all my sorrow, all my tears.
Russo: La la la la la...

Russo: Ahem, ahem!
Now, something's not quite right.{VAR BE01}
This here microphone's all screwy.
I can sing real good, promise!

Russo: Testing...
Check one, check two, check, check, yup.

Koontz: Singing gives life to my spirit.
Will you listen to the voice of my spirit?

Koontz: Huh? Are you leaving already?
I am always here.

Koontz: Oh, you want to listen to my song
after all! Yes!

Koontz: My song...
Don't you like it?

You are great!
I want to hire you.{VAR BE01}
What do you think?
Will you work here as a Waitress?

You are great!
I want to hire you.{VAR BE01}
What do you think?
Will you work here as a Waiter?
You should work here! What do you think?
Aww... That's too bad, but I understand!
Thank you! I hope you'll do a great job!{VAR BE01}
Thank you! I hope you'll do a great job!

What kind of sandwich does customer
number {VAR 0200 0000} want?

Well done! Thank you!
Give me a second to make the sandwiches.{VAR BE01}

The sandwiches are ready! Please
serve them to the correct customers.

I think you missed a couple of people.
Please take everyone's order!

This is a thank-you gift.
You've worked really hard!{VAR BE01}

That's it for today. I would be happy if
you could come back again tomorrow!

You're quitting? Well, that's OK.
Today is not busy, so it should be fine.

Oh! You're leaving the park.
Are you going to quit your Waitress job?

Oh! You're leaving the park.
Are you going to quit your Waiter job?

I'd like a {VAR 0109 0000} sandwich.
That's my Pokémon's favorite!

You can eat here with your Pokémon.
It's a really good sandwich shop!

Munch, munch...yummy!
My Pokémon is also happy.

Munch, munch...? Hmmm.
It tastes a little different this time...

We're really hungry today. So, a large
{VAR 0109 0000} sandwich, please!

My Pokémon has a big appetite,
just like me!

Gobble, gobble...delicious!
This is the highlight of my day!

Gobble, gobble...delicious! But I don't
think this is what I ordered...

My Pokémon has gourmet tastes.
I'd like a {VAR 0109 0000} sandwich, please.

A Berry dish for people and Pokémon!
The chef can show off her skill with it.

Nibble, nibble...
Oh, the flavors are simply divine!

Both my Pokémon and I are craving
a {VAR 0109 0000} sandwich! Please!

I'm happy to be able to eat with
my Pokémon.

Munch, munch. Open wide.
So happy!

Munch, munch... Huh?
It tastes different.
Myu myuweee.
Skwee weep...
Pikaaaa!
Kroooko!

Will you serve the {VAR 0109 0000} sandwich
to this customer?

entries.text:
Village Bridge Restaurant
Village Sandwiches are our specialty!
